exempt.PoubCheck.DifftestMain: the poub-check-difftest executable's entry point, one line; it serves PoubCheck.Difftest.table, audited under PoubCheck.Difftest, through the difftest server's line protocol: a test and not a proof
exempt.PoubCheck.VerifierMain: the poub-check-verifier executable's entry point, one line; it runs PoubCheck.Verifier.serve, audited under PoubCheck.Verifier
exempt.PoubCheck.ProtocolMain: the poub-check-protocol executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of PoubCheck.Protocol.protocol, audited under PoubCheck.Protocol and CoreProtocol

PoubCheck.why: the verifier is code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes and hm96, core's randomness, the core protocol interface its session is a component through (PoubCheck.Protocol), and PoUS's leaf and path check (PousCheck.Merkle, on which a P2 store's openings are checked, PoubCheck.P2); no Mathlib and nothing of Security. The difftest's table (PoubCheck.Difftest) also imports the difftest server
